title: Busted pumpkins
text:
Busted pumpkins. The pumpkins came to my house. In the bag they looked ok. One by one as I took them out of the bag I could see all of them had some kind of hole, pushed in foam. It seems that some where along the trip to my house people or machine was not very careful handling these pumpkins.
I tried to paint them, hoping by doing that I could cover-up the areas. I wasn't able to change how they looked. I'm disappointed!
